paragraphs: Some people who rent homes from local councils are angry. Their rent has gone up a lot this year. There were protests in Dublin, Wicklow and Leitrim.
Seamus Reidy uses a wheelchair and has a job. He lives in a council house in Leitrim. A letter said his rent would go from €37.30 to €159 a week. After he asked for help, the council cut it to €100.
In Ballymun in Dublin, Linda Roddy now pays €320 a week. That is double what she paid last year. She now owes money to the council.
Each council has its own rules for rent. Rent depends on how much a family earns. The Government is now looking at one set of rules for the whole country.
sentZh: 一些向地方議會租房的人很生氣。
他們今年的租金漲了很多。
都柏林、威克洛和利特里姆都出現了抗議。
謝默斯·雷迪坐輪椅，也有工作。
他住在利特里姆的一間議會住宅。
一封信說他的租金將從每週37.30歐元漲到159歐元。
他求助之後，議會把租金降到100歐元。
在都柏林的巴利蒙，琳達·羅迪現在每週付320歐元。
這是她去年所付租金的兩倍。
她現在欠議會錢。
每個議會都有自己的租金規則。
租金取決於家庭收入多少。
政府目前正在研究適用全國的一套規則。

paragraphs: Many council tenants across Ireland are unhappy after big increases in their rent. In recent weeks, there have been protests in Dublin, Wicklow and Leitrim.

Seamus Reidy, who works and uses a wheelchair, rents a bungalow from Leitrim County Council. He got a letter saying his weekly rent would rise from €37.30 to €159. With help from a money advice service, he asked for a hardship review, and the rent was cut to €100 a week.
In Ballymun, Linda Roddy's rent for a three-bed house has doubled to €320 a week since last year. She has fallen behind on payments and does not understand why the rent went up so much.
Councils set rents based on household income, but each council uses different rules. Dublin City Council says its tenants pay 15.3% of their income on average.
Some housing experts say the system no longer works well. The Government has promised to review council rents and bring in a national framework.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭各地許多議會租戶在租金大漲後感到不滿。
最近幾週，都柏林、威克洛和利特里姆都出現了抗議。
謝默斯·雷迪有工作並使用輪椅，他向利特里姆郡議會租了一間平房。
他收到一封信，說他的週租將從37.30歐元漲到159歐元。
在理財諮詢服務的幫助下，他申請了困難審查，租金降到每週100歐元。
在巴利蒙，琳達·羅迪三房住宅的租金自去年以來翻倍至每週320歐元。
她已拖欠租金，也不明白為何租金漲這麼多。
